messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — metering.token_count drift 7.2% over baseline in us-west-2 (usage-emit topic). potential double-counts. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift :rotating_light:

maria: oncall here, grabbing it. sam can you take emitter pipeline logs? bethany please watch billing dashboard / customer flags. kai pls check recent deploys.

sam: pulling logs now. tailing emitter-x stdout; seeing repeated ack loops from producer group 'emitters-v2' starting ~2026-03-21T00:12Z. suspect retry/backoff regression.

sam: quick query to estimate scope:
```sql
-- recent vs baseline token emits per minute
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) as minute, sum(tokens) FROM metering.emits
WHERE ts > now() - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute desc LIMIT 10;
```

sam: numbers show ~1.5x tokens for a subset of clients for ~20m window. rough affected tenant count ~24.

bethany: seeing ~22 customers with overage flags in billing UI, two have active alerts -> CS already pinged. pausing auto-escalation for billing alerts to avoid duplicate emails.

maria: good. kai any recent infra change?

kai: there was a non-critical release to emitter-x at 23:50 that adjusted retry/backoff and added a new batch flush path. I'm rolling that change back now (rolling 3 nodes).

deploy-bot: rollback started for service emitter-x (release 2026-03-21-2350) — rolling to prev stable 1.4.2 on pool gpu-prod-usw2.

kai: rollback 1/3 done, 2/3 in progress. health checks green so far.

sam: thank you — I kicked off a streaming dedupe job to drop suspected duplicate emits and reconcile counts in real time. job id job-457. params:
```json
{"job_id":"job-457","mode":"stream-dedupe","lookback_minutes":30,"emit_key":"client_request_id"}
```

bethany: pausing billing alerts now. I also created a billing reconciliation run to mark transient overage flags as "investigating" until we have final deltas.

sales-notify-bot: support-ticket created: #INC-8742 with affected tenants list (24). Notified CS slate: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-8742

maria: action checklist so far: 1) rollback deployed (kai) 2) dedupe job running (sam) 3) pause billing automations (bethany) 4) CS ticket created (sales-notify-bot). Next: run bounded backfill to recompute token counts for affected tenants, then produce final reconciliation and credit if needed.

sam: dedupe job reports initial reduction in tokens for the affected partition after 6 minutes; per-minute token emit rate dropping toward baseline. I'll run a conservative backfill after dedupe finishes — estimate ~2-3 hours.

kai: rollback completed across 3 nodes. deploy-bot: rollback complete — emitter-x now at 1.4.2.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-21-2350 -> rollback 1.4.3 -> 1.4.2 completed in 180s.

bethany: I'll hold on issuing any credits until reconciliation completes. CS draft comms ready (we'll say "transient billing flags; we're reconciling and will adjust if needed").

maria: agreed. tagging this as live mitigation. keep updates here. sam pls post a short reconciliation summary once backfill finishes (include net token delta per tenant).

sam: will do. initial ETA backfill completion ~2026-03-21T03:10Z.

maria: thanks team. reopening billing alerts when we confirm counts are stable. closing live pager after postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-20260321-01 (metering token drift). Severity P1 -> mitigated. Postmortem follow-up assigned to @sam @kai @bethany.
